description: Use when the user has a photo, screenshot, or image of a loan or credit-card offer letter (or describes a letter they received), including a letter that carries a LendMail Advisors review mark (printed with the address lendmail.fit/review), and wants to know who sent it, what the offer is, where the response or confirmation code is located, and whether it is worth responding to. Returns a plain-language read of the mailer. LendMail is not the lender and does not make credit decisions; lenders that are LendMail Advisors Contributors are identified by a verified LendMail Advisors review mark, and the result says when a mark is verified.
